derivation: from G4862 (σύν) and a derivative of a compound of G5259 (ὑπό) and the base of G2041 (ἔργον);
def: to be a co-auxiliary, i.e. assist

occurrences.text: Ye also helping together by prayer for us, that for the gift bestowed upon us by the means of many persons thanks may be given by many on our behalf.
